triples.tail_surface: Provisions for measurement of oil temperature are provided on the suction pipe of oil fuel pump
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 燃油泵吸入管油温测量装置
triples.evidence_text: Provisions for measurement of oil temperature are provided on the suction pipe of oil fuel pump

triples.tail_surface: Stop valves and/or cocks are provided on the inlet side and outlet side of the fuel oil strainers
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 燃油滤器进出口侧设置截止阀或旋塞
triples.evidence_text: Stop valves and/or cocks are provided on the inlet side and outlet side of the fuel oil strainers
Such spaces are to be sufficiently ventilated to prevent accumulation of oil vapor

triples.tail_surface: insulated with non-combustible, and preferably non-oil-absorbent, materials
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 使用不燃且最好不吸油材料隔热
triples.evidence_text: To prevent the ignition of fuel oil, all hot surfaces, e.g. steam and exhaust piping, turbochargers, exhaust gas boilers, etc. likely to reach a temperature above 220°C (428°F) during service are to be insulated with non-combustible, and preferably non-oil-absorbent, materials
The insulation assembly is to be well installed and supported having regard to its possible deterioration due to vibration

triples.head_surface: flanged joints, flanged bonnets and any other flanged or threaded connections in fuel oil piping systems under pressure exceeding 1.8 bar
triples.head_canonical_zh: 压力超过1.8bar的燃油管路法兰接头、法兰盖及其他法兰或螺纹连接
triples.tail_surface: Spray shields are to be fitted
triples.evidence_text: Spray shields are to be fitted around flanged joints, flanged bonnets and any other flanged or threaded connections in fuel oil piping systems under pressure exceeding 1.8 bar (1.84 kgf/cm2, 26 psi) which are located above or near units of high temperature
